mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rent_payment (order_id, pay_type, period, amount, pay_method, status, biz_no, tenant_txn_id, landlord_txn_id, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{payType}, #{period}, #{amount}, #{payMethod}, #{status}, #{bizNo}, #{tenantTxnId}, #{landlordTxnId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rent_payment WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
